notes: Co-op quiz progress is now remembered per quiz when the host returns to the lobby, including guessed Pokémon, shadows, revealed types, timers, scores, and multiple saved quizzes - Solo quiz progress is now remembered per quiz until the game is restarted - Hosts can start co-op quizzes alone, players can join after the quiz starts, and lobby rows now show which quiz the host is in - Added per-player quiz background color slider with black, pink, and turquoise support, and fixed its placement on every quiz type - Nicknames are now required before hosting or joining co-op - Improved lobby refreshes, quiz join notifications, and return-to-quiz behavior - The game now always starts on the main menu instead of sometimes opening Gen 1 directly
